tasks.title: Collect the owner's second report on v1.8.0: deploy it, have the owner press the twelve-button panel (1 to 10, then Save), copy the newest WoW screenshots and the saved FidelityEMatrix report into the repo on branch owner/reports (the worktree from the first run, never main) and push
steps: First deploy v1.8.0 of FidelityEMatrix the H005 way (git -C D:\fidelity-repo fetch origin, git -C D:\fidelity-repo merge --ff-only origin/francois/serene-euler-51wj3e, back up, robocopy D:\fidelity-repo\FidelityEMatrix to D:\World of Warcraft\_anniversary_\Interface\AddOns\FidelityEMatrix, hash check; 16 files; the toc must say 1.8.0). Then tell the owner: /reload, stand where the first report was taken (the Abbey door), /fide report, press the buttons top to bottom, 1 to 10 (each takes a screenshot half a second later; wait for the chat line before the next press), then Save (reload UI). Wait for the owner to say they are done.

Find the report file: D:\World of Warcraft\_anniversary_\WTF\Account\<the account folder>\SavedVariables\FidelityEMatrix.lua. It must contain FidelityEMatrix_Report with steps; read its at field (the report's start time). If it has no steps, stop and report blocked with blocked_on "owner: press the report buttons and Save (reload UI)".

Collect the screenshots: every file in D:\World of Warcraft\_anniversary_\Screenshots\ modified at or after that at time (if in doubt, the last two hours). List them with size and mtime. Skip any single file over 8 MB and name it in the report instead.

Prepare the reports worktree (never touch the deploy checkout's branch): if D:\fidelity-reports does not exist, run git -C D:\fidelity-repo fetch origin, then git -C D:\fidelity-repo worktree add -B owner/reports D:\fidelity-reports origin/owner/reports if that remote branch exists, else git -C D:\fidelity-repo worktree add -b owner/reports D:\fidelity-reports origin/francois/serene-euler-51wj3e. If it exists: git -C D:\fidelity-reports fetch origin and git -C D:\fidelity-reports pull --ff-only origin owner/reports (ignore the error if the remote branch does not exist yet).

Copy into D:\fidelity-reports\reports\<yyyymmdd-hhmm, the report's at time; a new folder, the first run's 20261104-0935 stays>\: the screenshots, the FidelityEMatrix.lua SavedVariables file, and a MANIFEST.txt listing every file with its size, mtime and Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256, plus the addon version from D:\fidelity-repo\FidelityEMatrix\FidelityEMatrix.toc and the client build from .build.info.
git -C D:\fidelity-reports add reports && git -C D:\fidelity-reports commit -m "report: owner screenshots and saved report <yyyymmdd-hhmm>" && git -C D:\fidelity-reports push -u origin owner/reports

If that push is rejected as non-fast-forward: git -C D:\fidelity-reports pull --ff-only origin owner/reports and then git -C D:\fidelity-reports push -u origin owner/reports. The branch is always owner/reports and the push is always plain: no other branch, no forcing of any kind.
Report the folder name, the file list with sizes, the commit hash and the push output. The director fetches origin/owner/reports and reads the lines there.
report: The deploy's hash count (expect 16) and version line
The report's at time and its number of steps
The screenshot list with sizes and any skipped file
The commit hash on owner/reports and the push output

Then walk across a zone line (Northshire into Elwynn) and type /fidelity audit: it must not say DEVIANT on its own. Paste the panel and the audit.
report: The merge result and the commit
The backup folder name, the robocopy summary, the hash count and any mismatch
After the owner check: the panel text and the audit output verbatim

tasks.title: Deploy FidelityEMatrix v1.7.5 from branch francois/serene-euler-51wj3e (the branch the owner already runs) to the TBC Anniversary client and WoW Forever when present; owner pastes the check list
steps: git -C D:\fidelity-repo fetch origin
git -C D:\fidelity-repo status --short (report it; if the tree is dirty, stop and report blocked with that output; never reset, clean, restore or checkout -f)

git -C D:\fidelity-repo checkout francois/serene-euler-51wj3e (a plain checkout of the branch; it creates the tracking branch the first time) then git -C D:\fidelity-repo merge --ff-only origin/francois/serene-euler-51wj3e. If the merge is not a fast-forward, stop and report blocked with the output of git status.

Confirm the version: Select-String '## Version' D:\fidelity-repo\FidelityEMatrix\FidelityEMatrix.toc must say 1.7.5 or later; otherwise report blocked with blocked_on "director: the branch tip is not v1.7.5" and stop.

npm --prefix D:\fidelity-repo install (once; fengari) then node D:\fidelity-repo\tools\test_ematrix_math.mjs (expect 12 passed, 0 failed) and node --test D:\fidelity-repo\tools\ematrix-lua.test.mjs D:\fidelity-repo\tools\ematrix-toc.test.mjs (expect 0 fail)

Back up the live addon first: rename D:\World of Warcraft\_anniversary_\Interface\AddOns\FidelityEMatrix to D:\World of Warcraft\_anniversary_\Interface\AddOns\FidelityEMatrix.bak-<yyyymmdd-hhmm> if it exists. Then copy: robocopy D:\fidelity-repo\FidelityEMatrix "D:\World of Warcraft\_anniversary_\Interface\AddOns\FidelityEMatrix" /E (no /MIR, no /PURGE).

Verify the copy: for every file under D:\fidelity-repo\FidelityEMatrix, Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 must equal the hash of the same relative path under D:\World of Warcraft\_anniversary_\Interface\AddOns\FidelityEMatrix; report the count of files compared (expect 15) and any mismatch. Expected files: EMatrix_Core.lua, EMatrix_Math.lua, EMatrix_World.lua, EMatrix_Terrain.lua, FidelityEMatrix.toc, FidelityEMatrix_Vanilla.toc, FidelityEMatrix_TBC.toc, Data\EMatrix_Data_Azeroth_tbc.lua, Data\EMatrix_Data_Azeroth_vanilla.lua, Media\*.tga (6).

If D:\World of Warcraft\_forever_\Interface\AddOns\FidelityEMatrix (or its parent AddOns folder) exists, do the same backup, copy and hash check there; report whether that client exists and its version from its .build.info if present.
Report the version from the toc and the commit (git -C D:\fidelity-repo rev-parse --short HEAD).

Owner, after /reload: paste the one login line (it says v1.7.5 and what came up, including cells with a source), /fide diag, /fide world status, /fide terrain probe (at the Northshire Abbey door), /fide terrain status, /fide status. Then /fide box show and click the box: say whether each cell visibly squashes and flashes as the wave crosses it (the flip now lasts 0.26 s; before it was one frame), whether the E wall still shows diagonal stripes of one orientation (it must not), and from which side the closed E tiles look lit (upper left is the known defect the atlas will fix). Set status blocked with blocked_on "owner: paste the login line, the probes and the box observations" until the owner reports.
report: git status before, the checkout and merge result (new HEAD), the toc version, all test summary lines
The backup folder name, the robocopy summary line, the hash comparison count (expect 15) and any mismatch, for each client
After the owner check: the login line and the probe/status output verbatim, then the three box observations

tasks.title: Laptop: set up webcam head tracking for FidelityEMatrix v1.6.0 (virtual gamepad)
steps: git -C D:\fidelity-repo fetch origin && git -C D:\fidelity-repo merge --ff-only origin/claude/ematrix-depth (same guard as H005: stop and report if not a fast-forward)
Read D:\fidelity-repo\tools\headtrack\README.md

OWNER-AUTHORISED (Piskriek, 2026-11-03): install the ViGEmBus driver. Download only from https://github.com/nefarius/ViGEmBus/releases (the latest ViGEmBus_*_x64.exe; record its version from the file name and Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256). Before running: Get-AuthenticodeSignature must report Valid and a SignerCertificate Subject containing "Nefarius"; report both lines. If it is already installed (Get-PnpDevice | Where FriendlyName -match ViGEm, or sc query ViGEmBus), skip the install and say so. Run the installer from an elevated prompt and record its exit code; if UAC appears on the laptop screen the owner clicks it. After it: sc query ViGEmBus must show RUNNING; report it. Do NOT reboot: if the installer asks for a reboot, stop, set blocked_on "owner: reboot the laptop, then restart hands_sync", and continue only after the owner says so.

python -m venv D:\fidelity-repo\.venv-headtrack ; D:\fidelity-repo\.venv-headtrack\Scripts\pip install -r D:\fidelity-repo\tools\headtrack\requirements.txt (report the installed versions of opencv-python, numpy and vgamepad)

Close WoW first if it is running (check_pad drives a real virtual pad). D:\fidelity-repo\.venv-headtrack\Scripts\python D:\fidelity-repo\tools\headtrack\check_pad.py must print PASS; if XInput sees no device, report it and stop (do not reboot).

Find out which process holds the webcam (the fractal daemons): if the camera is free, the tracker uses --source 0; if a daemon owns it, find what it exposes (a folder of frames or an MJPEG stream) and use --source frames:<dir> or --source <url>. Report which, and the process name.

Start the tracker only when the owner is at the laptop (it calibrates on the face it sees in the first 2 s): D:\fidelity-repo\.venv-headtrack\Scripts\python D:\fidelity-repo\tools\headtrack\headtrack.py --show. Keep it running. Report its first console lines and the contents of D:\fidelity-repo\tools\headtrack\head.json after 10 s. To stop it later: press q in its window.

Hand to the owner for the in-game part, and record the prior values first (/dump GetCVar("GamePadEnable"), GetCVar("GamePadCameraYawSpeed"), GetCVar("GamePadCameraPitchSpeed")) so they can be restored: /console GamePadEnable 1, /console GamePadCameraYawSpeed 0, /console GamePadCameraPitchSpeed 0, then /fide eye probe while moving the head, /fide eye calibrate sitting normally, /fide eye source gamepad; then lean left/right and report whether the scene follows the head and the /fide eye line.
report: ViGEmBus: version, SHA-256, signature lines, installer exit code, sc query state, whether a reboot was requested
Installed Python package versions
check_pad.py output
which camera source the tracker uses and why, and the holder process
head.json after 10 s
the prior CVar values, the /fide eye probe line, and whether the scene follows the head
